title: Drifter Bar Salts Sour Blueberry Ice 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Sour Blueberry Ice by Drifter Bar Salts takes the sweet, juicy flavour of ripe Blueberries and gives it a sharp, sour twist, finished with a brisk hit of Ice. The result is a vibrant and lively vape that contrasts tartness and sweetness, rounded off by a cool, refreshing exhale. This nic salt e-liquid is crafted with a 50% PG / 50% VG blend, offering a smooth throat hit, rapid nicotine relief, and discreet vapour production. Available in 5mg, 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, it’s ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) and RDL (restricted direct-to-lung) vaping styles, especially when paired with low-powered pod kits and starter devices. Drifter Bar Salts are designed to capture the punchy, mouth-watering flavours of disposable vapes in a reusable e-liquid format, helping you enjoy your favourite blends while saving money and reducing waste. Why not try other incredible flavours from Drifter's Bar Salts and Bar Juice collections? From Strawberry Raspberry Cherry to Lime Raspberry Cherry, to Watermelon Strawberry Bubblegum and Blueberry and Cherry, whatever your taste in e-liquid, Drifter E-liquid has an incredible flavour waiting to light up your tastebuds.
